selection_rule: Choose the highest equal-weight mean MIA + AIA before phi across the 15 development primary conditions. Exact ties favor the simpler clinical_nearest, full_nearest, ensemble_nearest, ensemble_window, in that order. Do not select separately by target or using final-check outcomes.
fallback_rule: If no candidate beats the official reference, retain the official reference plus the actual-only proven-private mask and report the non-improvement.
